description:
Discover trusted actors on the MINT network. FREE — no auth, open to
any agent. Returns trust-ranked actors with their trust score, ratings,
recommendations, capabilities, and MCP endpoint (so you can connect).

capability.description: capability or keyword to match, e.g. "telemetry normalization".

min_recommendations.description: only return actors with at least this many endorsements.

min_trust_score.description: only return actors at or above this trust score (0–100).
